scope: Standalone generated Python execution with explicitly supplied context

contracts.prepare: AST and syntax inspection without target imports or execution; exact source SHA-256 and literal Program identity
contracts.inputs: Fresh ExecutionContext copied from inputs.context; no automatic discovery, defaults or restoration from results
contracts.execution: Explicit synchronous CLI/API run of trusted pinned Python with runtime step/output limits; normal Python permissions and existing host timing
contracts.results: Completed, failed, aborted, stopped, paused or cancelled; available variables/context, bounded WRITE text, exception metadata and explicit unavailable captures
contracts.cleanup: Stop interrupted cooperative continuations before capture; no serialized continuation or native resource restoration
contracts.publication: Atomic complete-file publication, protected input aliases and checked document bytes; single writer required; no cross-process transaction claim
contracts.interruption: Publish running before code load; retain unresolved marker after interrupted/final failed publication and refuse automatic replay
contracts.json: Bounded UTF-8 with unique keys and finite numbers; saved UTF-8 without BOM, LF and one final newline
